observation.visible_scene: A small single-engine propeller aircraft, seen as a dark silhouette against a pale blue sky with soft clouds, flies while emitting a continuous white smoke trail that marks the path it has just traveled. The aircraft remains the sole moving object throughout the excerpt.
visible_changes: The aircraft's body orientation rotates continuously in the image plane: it begins with the fuselage nearly vertical, nose up (frames 1-6), tilts to a near-horizontal, nose-right attitude (frames 7-12), swings back through diagonal and vertical poses (frames 13-36), and returns toward a horizontal nose-right pose at the end (frames 37-41).
The aircraft's position within the frame drifts leftward and slightly upward over the excerpt, moving from center-left toward the upper-left region.

The white smoke trail persists the whole time but its visible shape evolves: the long, steeply descending curve at the lower left in the early frames flattens into a more horizontal, thinner line behind the aircraft in the later frames.
The older, far end of the smoke trail shifts leftward and progressively moves out of the left edge of the frame.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the sequence is part of a named aerobatic figure (loop, roll, etc.), and what happens before the crop starts and after it ends.
The 3D flight path and true airspeed of the aircraft, which are not directly observable from the silhouette alone.
Whether any drift seen is due to wind affecting the smoke.
uncertain_details: The exact mix of pitch versus roll of the aircraft at each moment, since the small silhouette can be read from different viewing angles.
Whether the leftward/upward movement of the aircraft in the frame is the aircraft translating through the scene or a camera pan/tilt, as background cloud cues are weak.
Precise geometry of the smoke trail in three dimensions.
